Definition: Ellasar, an early country of Asia
BiblicalUsage: Ellasar is an early country of Asia. In Genesis 14:1, the text says "Arioch king of Ellasar." It is a place, not a person, so there is no People profile for it.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Ellasar matters because God's story happened in real places, and Ellasar is one of them.
